title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・悲願、成就す

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen beats out Mejiro Ryan and the rest of the competition, achieving her ultimate goal in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Filled with emotion, she announces her victory and expresses her gratitude to everyone in her family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing her words, the crowd continues to cheer for her a while longer.
